ingredientSections.heading: Scallop Ceviche
items: 200g large fresh scallops with the abductor muscle removed

methodSections.heading: Scallop Ceviche
steps: Stir the marinade ingredients together in a small sealable container.
Add the scallops and marinate in the refrigerator for around 6 hours.

methodSections.heading: Yam Jam
steps: Peel the yams and slice into a 1cm dice. Place in a bowl, add the ginger and olive oil and mix well so the yam is evenly coated.
Transfer the yams to an oven tray, spread out evenly and roast for roughly 40 minutes, or until tender.
Roughly chop the apricots, place in a heat-proof container and pour boiling water over to just cover them. Stir through the sugar let sit and rehydrate for 15-20 minutes.
Dice the onion finely and sauté with a splash of oil over a medium heat until translucent.
Finely dice the red onion, de-seed and finely dice the jalapeño and roughly chop the cilantro.
Allow the yams to cool, transfer them to a mixing bowl and coarsely mash them with a fork.
Fold in the sautéed onion, rehydrated apricots, rice wine vinegar, diced red onions, diced jalapeño and cilantro.
Season to taste and then refrigerate.

methodSections.heading: Charred Buttered Corn
steps: Husk the corn, cut into 2in rounds and steam for around 5 minutes or until tender.
Chargrill the cooked corn to add some colour and then douse in salted butter.
Arrange the charred buttered corn on serving plates, spoon the cold Yam Jam on top of the corn and garnish with fresh cilantro.
Top with scallops and season with good-quality sea salt.
